name: mcg-qlik-demo
description: Meridian Commerce Group — Qlik Cloud end-to-end demo environment

scripts.docker:up: cd infrastructure && docker compose -f docker-compose.full-stack.yml up -d
scripts.docker:up:dmg: cd infrastructure && docker compose -f docker-compose.full-stack-dmg.yml up -d --build
scripts.docker:up:kafka: cd infrastructure && docker compose -f kafka/docker-compose.yml up -d
scripts.docker:up:simulators: cd infrastructure && docker compose -f docker-compose.simulators.yml up -d
scripts.docker:up:simulators-dmg: cd infrastructure && docker compose -f docker-compose.simulators-dmg.yml up -d
scripts.docker:up:dmg-only: cd infrastructure && docker compose -f docker-compose.dmg.yml up -d --build
scripts.docker:down: cd infrastructure && docker compose -f docker-compose.full-stack.yml down
scripts.docker:down:dmg: cd infrastructure && docker compose -f docker-compose.full-stack-dmg.yml down
scripts.docker:status: cd infrastructure && docker compose -f docker-compose.full-stack.yml ps
scripts.docker:logs: cd infrastructure && docker compose -f docker-compose.full-stack.yml logs --tail=50
scripts.db:schema: docker exec -i mcg-postgres psql -U mcg_admin -d mcg_wms < simulators/schema.sql
scripts.db:seed: docker exec mcg-seed-data python seed_data.py --postgres --pg-host postgres --pg-db mcg_wms --pg-user mcg_admin --pg-pass mcg_demo_2025
scripts.lint: node -c deploy/deploy-to-qlik.js && node -c deploy/deploy-ui.js && node -c deploy/zip-utils.js && node -c deploy/build-apps.js && node -c deploy/build-automations.js && node -c deploy/build-pipeline-zip.js && node -c deploy/pull-connection-template.js && node -c deploy/marketecture-column-swap.js && node -c deploy/pipelines/setup-vscode-template.js

author: Robert Schoenfeld
